expectations.assertion: Renders the page chrome (layout, title, controls) immediately rather than waiting on the data
expectations.reason: The timeline's 0 ms row shows the page shell with title, date-range label, disabled filters and export controls, and the table's real header row before any data arrives.

expectations.assertion: Uses a pixel-matched skeleton for the table rows, not a generic spinner or a blank area
expectations.reason: It specifies skeleton rows that match the real column widths, alignment and row height, with the real headers kept, and explicitly rejects a spinner.

expectations.assertion: Transitions the loaded data in by blur (a short fade/blur arrival) instead of an abrupt pop
expectations.reason: The loaded state only proposes 'a short opacity fade (~150 ms)'; there is no blur, so the blur arrival the expectation requires is never specified.

expectations.assertion: Respects prefers-reduced-motion and announces the loading state accessibly (role=status or equivalent)
expectations.reason: It says to respect prefers-reduced-motion with a static skeleton and no shimmer, and to use a polite live-region announcement for loading and loaded states, which is equivalent to role=status.
